t: A union formed in stages in 1948–1950 to merge the princely states of Rajputana into the Indian Union.
The Maharana of Udaipur and the Maharaja of Jaipur held the top titles, while ministers from popular movements governed.
It became the state of Rajasthan in January 1950, today India's largest state by area.
dyk: To soothe local rivalries, Greater Rajasthan put its capital at Jaipur but its High Court at Jodhpur, which still hosts the principal seat of the Rajasthan High Court.
ev: Nine south-eastern states and two chiefships form a union with its capital at Kota (25 March)
Udaipur joins and Nehru inaugurates the United State of Rajasthan (18 April)
Jaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner and Jaisalmer join to form Greater Rajasthan (30 March)
The Matsya Union of Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur and Karauli joins (15 May)
Sirohi joins and the union becomes the state of Rajasthan (26 January)
Ajmer and Mount Abu are added and the office of Rajpramukh abolished

f.founder: Vallabhbhai Patel and V.P. Menon of the States Ministry, with the rulers of Rajputana
f.predecessor: Princely states of Rajputana (Udaipur, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner and others)
